title: Stuffed Zucchini
description: Parboiled zucchini halves filled with their own chopped pulp, sautéed onion, green pepper, pimiento and herb stuffing, topped with mozzarella. Can be made a day ahead.

steps.heading: Parboil
steps.text: Bring 2 inches of salted water (½ tsp salt per cup of water) to a boil. Add the zucchini, cover, and cook until tender, 8 to 10 minutes; drain.

steps.heading: Hollow
steps.text: Cool slightly, then cut each zucchini in half lengthwise. Spoon out the pulp and chop it coarsely. Set the shells cut side up in an ungreased 11x7-inch baking pan.

steps.heading: Fill
steps.text: Cook and stir the onion in the butter in a 10-inch skillet until tender. Stir in the chopped pulp, green pepper, pimiento and stuffing mix. Divide among the zucchini halves and sprinkle each with about 1 tbsp cheese.

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Bake uncovered at 350°F until hot and the cheese is melted, 25 to 30 minutes.

notes: Make-ahead: after filling, cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 30 to 35 minutes (start about 40 minutes before serving).
